WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_average 
  FROM signals 
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
),
telescope_avgs AS (
  SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse
  FROM signals
  WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY telescref
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT telescref, avg_pulse
  FROM telescope_avgs
  WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg)
),
second_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as second_average 
  FROM above_overall
),
final_telescopes AS (
  SELECT avg_pulse
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT second_average FROM second_avg)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse_rate,
  AVG(avg_pulse) - (SELECT overall_average FROM overall_avg) as avg_above_overall,
  AVG(avg_pulse) - (SELECT second_average FROM second_avg) as avg_above_second
FROM final_telescopes
